'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Papua conflict]]
**Five [[Free Papua Movement]] militants are killed during a [[shootout]] with [[Indonesian Army|Indonesian soldiers]] and [[Indonesian National Police|police officers]] in the [[Papua (province)|Papua province]]. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-rebels-killed-papua-clash-cf782b546baae8533ab40d6e680c4755 (AP)]
*[[Armenia–Azerbaijan border crisis]]
**[[Azerbaijan]] accuses [[Armenia]] of using a [[sniper]] to kill one of [[Azerbaijani Armed Forces|its soldiers]] in the city of [[Kalbajar]]. Armenia denies involvement in the incident. [https://www.thestar.com.my/news/world/2023/09/30/azerbaijan-says-serviceman-killed-by-sniper-armenia-denies-incident (''The Star'')]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Two [[Morena (political party)|Morena party]] pollsters are killed and a third is kidnapped in [[Juárez, Chiapas]], [[Mexico]]. A note was left on the bodies from the [[Jalisco New Generation Cartel]], threatening [[Federal government of Mexico|the government]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/pollsters-killed-kidnapped-mexico-cartel-sign-reportedly-left-with-victims/ (CBS News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Maldivian presidential election]]
**[[Maldivians]] vote in a [[run-off election]] between candidates [[Mohamed Muizzu]] and [[Ibrahim Mohamed Solih]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/maldives-presidential-run-off-pits-pro-india-pro-china-figures-2023-09-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[2023 Slovak parliamentary election]]
**[[Slovaks]] elect the 150 members of the [[National Council (Slovakia)|National Council]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/slovaks-choose-between-pro-russian-ex-pm-fico-pro-western-liberals-2023-09-29/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 United States federal budget]]
**The [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House of Representatives]] and [[United States Senate|U.S. Senate]] pass a 45-day stopgap measure bill backed by [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|House Speaker]] [[Kevin McCarthy]]. President [[Joe Biden]] signs the bill, averting a government shutdown. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/09/30/politics/us-government-shutdown-latest/index.html (CNN)]
*Aftermath of the [[2023 Guatemalan general election]]
**The office of the [[Attorney General of Guatemala]] seizes the tally sheets of votes from the [[general election]] and the runoff. The judges of the [[Supreme Electoral Tribunal (Guatemala)|Supreme Electoral Tribunal]] opposed the seizure but were attacked by police and prosecutors. Electoral tribunal officials were also intimidated. [https://apnews.com/article/guatemala-arevalo-elections-standoff-4950f85160c5354f9610a8282dc22e94 (AP)] [https://www.prensalibre.com/guatemala/politica/vicepresidenta-electa-llama-a-defender-la-democracia-y-a-manifestaciones-pacificas/ (''Prensa Libre'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 AFL season]]
**[[Collingwood Football Club|Collingwood]] defeats the [[Brisbane Lions]] by four points to win the [[2023 AFL Grand Final]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2023/sep/30/afl-grand-final-2023-collingwood-magpies-brisbane-lions-match-report-results-winner (''The Guardian'')]
